tasks.label: Build Package
tasks.command: pkgs=($(colcon list --names-only --base-paths src)); [ ${#pkgs[@]} -eq 0 ] && { echo "No packages found"; exit 1; }; echo "Select package:"; for i in "${!pkgs[@]}"; do echo "$((i+1))) ${pkgs[$i]}"; done; read -p "Enter number: " idx; pkg=${pkgs[$((idx-1))]}; [ -z "$pkg" ] && { echo "Invalid selection"; exit 1; }; echo "Building $pkg"; colcon build --packages-select "$pkg" --symlink-install --parallel-workers $(nproc) --cmake-args -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON && python3 ${workspaceFolder}/src/jimmbot_robot/scripts/merge_compile_commands.py ${workspaceFolder}/build

tasks.label: Kill All ROS/Gazebo Instances
tasks.command: current_pid=$$; patterns=('ros2 ' 'gz sim' 'ros_gz' 'parameter_bridge' 'robot_state_publisher' 'joint_state_publisher' 'rviz2'); echo 'Before:'; pgrep -af 'ros2 |gz sim|ros_gz|parameter_bridge|robot_state_publisher|joint_state_publisher|rviz2' || true; pids=$(for pattern in "${patterns[@]}"; do pgrep -f -- "$pattern" || true; done | sort -u | grep -vw "$current_pid" || true); if [[ -n "$pids" ]]; then echo "Stopping PIDs: $pids"; kill $pids 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; remaining=$(for pattern in "${patterns[@]}"; do pgrep -f -- "$pattern" || true; done | sort -u | grep -vw "$current_pid" || true); if [[ -n "$remaining" ]]; then echo "Force killing PIDs: $remaining"; kill -9 $remaining 2>/dev/null || true; fi; else echo 'No matching ROS/Gazebo processes found.'; fi; echo 'After:'; pgrep -af 'ros2 |gz sim|ros_gz|parameter_bridge|robot_state_publisher|joint_state_publisher|rviz2' || true

tasks.label: Stop jimmbot Gazebo
tasks.command: current_pid=$$; patterns=('ros2 launch jimmbot_gazebo jimmbot_(simple|empty)_world\.launch(\.py)?' 'gz sim .*jimmbot_gazebo/share/jimmbot_gazebo/media/worlds/simple\.world' 'gz sim .*jimmbot_gazebo/share/jimmbot_gazebo/media/worlds/empty\.world' 'gz sim .*empty\.sdf'); for pattern in "${patterns[@]}"; do while read -r pid; do [[ -z "$pid" || "$pid" == "$current_pid" ]] && continue; kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; done < <(pgrep -f -- "$pattern" || true); done

tasks.label: Launch jimmbot Empty World
tasks.command: source /opt/ros/$ROS_DISTRO/setup.bash && source ${workspaceFolder}/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch jimmbot_gazebo jimmbot_empty_world.launch.py
